description: Drive one or more node parameters over time with an LFO (sine/triangle/ramp/square/pulse/random). Creates an LFO CHOP and binds each target so it oscillates between min and max with the given period — movement without manual keyframing.

container_path.description: Where to create the LFO CHOP; defaults to the first target's parent network.

max.description: High end of the value sweep.

min.description: Low end of the value sweep.

period_seconds.description: Seconds for one full cycle (lower = faster).

targets.description: Parameters to animate, each written as 'nodePath.parName' (e.g. '/project1/sys/blur1.size'). Each is switched to expression mode so it tracks the oscillator live.

waveform.description: Oscillator shape. Every waveform sweeps the full min–max range.

name: animate_parameter
title: Animate parameter
